note: Walworth County SD (46129) publishes parcels only through the Schneider Beacon viewer (beacon.schneidercorp.com), a Cloudflare-protected web app with no public ArcGIS REST or bulk parcel service. County site links (Director of Equalization, Quick Links, Planning and Zoning, zoning map) list no ArcGIS services. The open-walco.opendata.arcgis.com hub belongs to Walworth County, Wisconsin, not SD. ArcGIS searches for Walworth SD parcels returned nothing; the neighbouring District III and 1st District servers have no Walworth service.
